title: CCFinance: Reconstructing Financial News Samples from Web Archives
abstract: arXiv:2611.30737v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proprietary news archives assign stories to firms, so reproducing a financial study often requires access to both the articles and the vendor's assignments. CCFinance lets researchers reconstruct firm coverage under different selection rules by recording which version of a story was captured, which issuers it names and how often each appears. From 14.8 million English-language records in Fine News, derived from public Common Crawl News, we identify 5.22 million distinct, consistently dated articles with issuer links. Exact reconstruction requires the restricted snapshot and derived artifacts. We compare GLiNER and Stanza on 250 model-labeled article leads and assess issuer links and story focus against blinded model judgments. Estimated precision among 475 accepted links is 96.8%. translated_title: CCFinance：从网络档案中重构金融新闻样本
translated_abstract: 专有新闻档案将新闻故事分配给公司，因此重现一项金融研究通常需要同时访问文章本身以及供应商的分配结果。CCFinance 使研究人员能够在不同的选择规则下重构公司的新闻报道覆盖情况，其做法是记录某个新闻故事的哪个版本被捕获、它提及了哪些发行主体（issuers）以及每个主体出现的频率。在源自公开 Common Crawl News 的 Fine News 数据集中，我们从 1480 万条英文记录中识别出 522 万篇日期一致、带有发行主体链接的不同文章。精确的重构需要受限的快照及衍生数据产物。我们在 250 篇由模型标注的文章导语上对 GLiNER 和 Stanza 进行了比较，并依据盲测的模型判断评估了发行主体链接和新闻焦点。在 475 条被接受的链接中，估计精确率达到 96.8%。在检测到公司的保留测试文章中，要求三次提及可将主体精确率从 31.9% 提升至 66.1%。在 2017-2025 年的面板数据中，相同的规……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CCFinance 基于公开的 Common Crawl 新闻数据构建了包含 522 万篇日期一致且带公司链接的金融文章数据集，使研究者无需依赖专有新闻档案即可在不同选择规则下重现公司新闻覆盖样本，其公司链接的估计精确率达 96.8%。
en_tdlr: CCFinance is a dataset of 5.22 million consistently dated financial news articles with issuer links derived from public Common Crawl archives, enabling researchers to reconstruct firm news coverage samples under different selection rules without proprietary archives, achieving an estimated link precision of 96.8%.
